packageRules.description: psycopg loads the compiled parts of the same psycopg-binary version: updated apart (PRs #606/#607), every database import fails.
init/analyze/upload-sarif share on-disk state and must move together -- a version mismatch between them fails the job outright.
Major updates can break things: reviewed by hand, never merged automatically.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Bundle all currently-advised fixes into one PR -- a CI vulnerability scan checks the whole dependency tree, not just the diff, so one-PR-per-package left every PR blocked by whichever other CVE hadn't landed yet.
